answer: A claim is proven by a live repair. A warden slips a fault into the job, breaking its pulse. The claimant has one hour to find and fix it while a prism auditor watches each move and a lotus warden checks the job against the sealed reference. A patched fault, a copied fix, or silence is a broken pulse: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and one repair buy an honest worker its pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and staff 1,000 live repairs.
